title: Persistent leaderboard / 本機排行榜
description: Reusable dependency-free JavaScript component, not a whole game. Adds top-five numeric scores in localStorage, clear control, and safe text rendering. Listens to game-score events with detail {score,finished:true}; works with curated Snake and Maze. Can also call returned API.record(score).
usage: Copy scoreboard.js alongside your HTML. Load after game code and call Scoreboard.attach({selector:"main",key:"my-game-scores",limit:5}). Record only finished games. API: record(score), clear(), scores(), destroy().
verification: Chromium fixture acceptance 2026-10-02: controls/persistence/offline and canonical game captures exercised. Full-board wins and physical Safari unverified. Fixture evidence is not future model-delivery evidence.
